models.title: User & Seller Model
models.overview: Comprehensive Mongoose schema representing Administrators, Brand Sellers, and Seller Team Members.
models.purpose: Handles core user identity, credentials, role associations, subscription plans, quotas, and profile metadata.

keyFields.name: _id
keyFields.description: Unique MongoDB ObjectId identifier

keyFields.name: name
keyFields.description: Full name of the registered user

keyFields.name: email
keyFields.description: Unique lowercased email address used for login

keyFields.name: password
keyFields.description: Bcrypt hashed password (stripped in toJSON serialization)

keyFields.name: role
keyFields.description: System role level ('admin', 'seller', 'user')

keyFields.name: role_id
keyFields.description: Reference to custom RBAC role in tbl_roles

keyFields.name: plan_id
keyFields.description: Active subscription plan reference in tbl_plans

keyFields.name: plan_limits
keyFields.description: Quotas: maxMarketplaces, maxReviewRequests, maxTeamMembers

keyFields.name: seller_id
keyFields.description: Parent seller reference for staff members

keyFields.name: status
keyFields.description: Account status: 0=Inactive, 1=Active, 2=Deleted

notes: Passwords are automatically hashed pre-save via bcrypt using 8 salt rounds.
Contains helper method isPasswordMatch() for validating credentials during login.
Private fields such as password and __v are hidden automatically by toJSON plugin.

models.title: Amazon Order & Solicitations Model
models.overview: Synchronized Amazon customer orders retrieved from Selling Partner API (SP-API) for feedback management.
models.purpose: Stores order fulfillment status, purchase dates, delivery estimates, and automated review request tracking.

keyFields.name: amazonOrderId
keyFields.description: Unique Amazon 19-character Order ID (e.g. 302-1234567-8901234)

keyFields.name: userId
keyFields.description: Seller account ObjectId who owns the store

keyFields.name: marketplaceId
keyFields.description: Amazon Marketplace identifier (e.g. A1PA6795UKMFR9 for DE)

keyFields.name: orderStatus
keyFields.description: Current Amazon status: Shipped, Delivered, Unshipped, Canceled

keyFields.name: fulfillmentChannel
keyFields.description: AFN (Fulfilled by Amazon) or MFN (Merchant Fulfilled Network)

keyFields.name: orderTotal
keyFields.description: Currency code and total purchase amount

keyFields.name: isReviewSent
keyFields.description: Boolean flag preventing duplicate solicitation emails

keyFields.name: reviewSentDate
keyFields.description: Timestamp when review solicitation was dispatched

notes: Unique compound indexing on amazonOrderId guarantees zero order duplication.
The review solicitation cron evaluates orders whose delivery date satisfies the delay threshold.

models.title: Amazon SP-API Credentials Model
models.overview: Amazon Selling Partner API (SP-API) Login with Amazon (LWA) OAuth credentials and seller store tokens.
models.purpose: Authorizes secure programmatic access to Amazon Order and Solicitation endpoints.

keyFields.name: userId
keyFields.description: Reference to seller user in tbl_users

keyFields.name: seller_id
keyFields.description: Amazon Merchant ID / Selling Partner Seller ID

keyFields.name: client_id
keyFields.description: Amazon LWA OAuth App Client ID

keyFields.name: client_secret
keyFields.description: Amazon LWA OAuth App Secret (encrypted)

keyFields.name: refresh_token
keyFields.description: Long-lived refresh token for generating access tokens

keyFields.name: activeMarketplaces
keyFields.description: Array of authorized Amazon marketplace IDs

notes: Tokens are used by the background scheduler to mint short-lived LWA access tokens.
Supports multi-marketplace selling across Germany, France, Italy, Spain, UK, Netherlands.

models.title: Subscription Plan Model
models.overview: Tiered subscription packages governing marketplace count, review quotas, and feature entitlements.
models.purpose: Defines pricing tiers, feature lists, and monthly quota ceilings for brand sellers.

keyFields.name: name
keyFields.description: Commercial plan name (e.g. Starter, Professional, Enterprise)

keyFields.name: price
keyFields.description: Subscription charge in EUR

keyFields.name: marketplace
keyFields.description: Maximum number of connected Amazon marketplaces

keyFields.name: request_quota
keyFields.description: Monthly review solicitation requests quota ceiling

keyFields.name: status
keyFields.description: Plan state: 0=Inactive, 1=Active, 2=Deleted

notes: Synced directly with Stripe subscription price IDs for automated recurring billing.
Used by backend rate limits and middleware to protect review solicitation quotas.

models.title: Stripe Billing & Payments Model
models.overview: Persisted Stripe checkout sessions, successful charges, invoices, and billing histories.
models.purpose: Maintains financial transaction records and triggers seller plan activations via webhooks.

keyFields.name: email
keyFields.description: Billing email address of the payer

keyFields.name: planId
keyFields.description: Purchased subscription plan reference

keyFields.name: amount
keyFields.description: Total payment amount charged

keyFields.name: stripeSessionId
keyFields.description: Stripe Checkout Session identifier

keyFields.name: status
keyFields.description: Payment state: 'pending', 'paid', 'failed'

notes: Updated asynchronously upon receiving cryptographically signed Stripe webhook events.
Prevents race conditions by verifying stripeSessionId idempotency.

models.title: RBAC Role & Permissions Model
models.overview: Granular Role-Based Access Control matrix governing section access (view, create, update, delete).
models.purpose: Enables administrators and sellers to create custom roles and assign precise permissions.

keyFields.name: role
keyFields.description: Machine-readable slug identifier (e.g. catalog_specialist)

keyFields.name: title
keyFields.description: Human-readable display name for the role

keyFields.name: scope
keyFields.description: Applicability domain: 'admin' or 'seller'

keyFields.name: sectionPermissions
keyFields.description: Array of { section, canView, canCreate, canUpdate, canDelete }

notes: Evaluated dynamically by checkPermission middleware before controller execution.
System administrator role bypasses permission checks automatically.

models.title: System Sections & Modules Model
models.overview: Registry of platform modules and dashboard navigation items available for permission assignment.
models.purpose: Centralizes available features and controls navigation visibility across admin and seller panels.

keyFields.name: name
keyFields.description: Section unique key identifier (e.g. 'orders', 'settings')

keyFields.name: title
keyFields.description: Display title for the navigation item

keyFields.name: scope
keyFields.description: Section scope: 'admin' or 'seller'

keyFields.name: order
keyFields.description: Sorting index for visual navigation ordering

notes: Acts as the master schema for constructing role permission checkboxes.
Supports dynamic module activation and deactivation without code changes.

models.title: Amazon Marketplaces Registry
models.overview: Amazon supported global country marketplaces, identifiers, regions, and currency codes.
models.purpose: Stores Amazon marketplace configurations for Germany, France, Italy, Spain, UK, etc.

keyFields.name: marketplace_id
keyFields.description: Amazon official Marketplace ID (e.g. A1PA6795UKMFR9)

keyFields.name: country_code
keyFields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (DE, FR, IT, ES)

keyFields.name: country
keyFields.description: English name of the country

keyFields.name: status
keyFields.description: 0: Inactive, 1: Active, 2: Deleted

notes: Pre-seeded with official Amazon Selling Partner EU and North American marketplaces.

models.title: Automation Settings & Schedule Model
models.overview: Seller review automation campaign configurations, scheduled execution hours, and filters.
models.purpose: Stores seller preferences for automated review solicitation delays and active marketplace targets.

keyFields.name: userId
keyFields.description: Seller account ObjectId

keyFields.name: amazonCredentialId
keyFields.description: Selected Amazon SP-API credential

keyFields.name: activeMarketplaces
keyFields.description: Marketplaces targeted for review solicitations

keyFields.name: schedule_time
keyFields.description: Time of day when solicitation cron executes (e.g. '14:00')

keyFields.name: review_delay_days
keyFields.description: Days to wait after delivery before soliciting reviews

notes: Controls the review solicitation worker to send compliant requests within Amazon guidelines (5-30 days).

models.title: Blog & Content Articles Model
models.overview: Public marketing website blog articles, SEO slugs, rich text content, and banners.
models.purpose: Content management system powering informative articles and SEO landing pages.

keyFields.name: blog_title
keyFields.description: Article headline and H1 title

keyFields.name: slug
keyFields.description: URL-friendly slug (e.g. 'how-to-automate-amazon-reviews')

keyFields.name: short_description
keyFields.description: Summary excerpt for cards and meta descriptions

keyFields.name: description
keyFields.description: Full article body content

keyFields.name: banner_image
keyFields.description: Hero banner image URL

notes: Indexed by slug for fast server-side and client-side blog routing.

models.title: Support Tickets & Inquiries Model
models.overview: Customer inquiries, contact forms, and seller technical support requests.
models.purpose: Tracks customer support issues, status (pending, in-progress, resolved), and response trails.

keyFields.name: name
keyFields.description: Name of the customer or seller submitting request

keyFields.name: email
keyFields.description: Contact email address for follow-ups

keyFields.name: message
keyFields.description: Detailed inquiry message or bug report

keyFields.name: status
keyFields.description: Ticket status: 'pending', 'in-progress', 'resolved'

notes: Admin panel provides direct response and status update capabilities.

models.title: System Audit & Security Logs Model
models.overview: Immutable audit trail recording administrative actions, payload diffs, and security events.
models.purpose: Ensures compliance and security accountability across all user, plan, and role modifications.

keyFields.name: operation
keyFields.description: Action identifier (e.g. 'CREATE_USER', 'UPDATE_PLAN')

keyFields.name: operation_by
keyFields.description: Admin user ObjectId who triggered the action

keyFields.name: key
keyFields.description: Entity key or module name affected

keyFields.name: operation_data
keyFields.description: Before and after data snapshot payload

keyFields.name: ip_address
keyFields.description: Client IP address captured from request header

notes: Written asynchronously by systemLog utility without blocking client responses.

models.title: Website Branding Configuration Model
models.overview: Global brand profile, company legal information, contact coordinates, and social media links.
models.purpose: Centralizes customizable site metadata powering the public website and footer waves.

keyFields.name: company
keyFields.description: Name, website, tagline, about, copyright_text

keyFields.name: contact
keyFields.description: Email, phone, postal address, support hours

keyFields.name: social_links
keyFields.description: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube URLs

notes: Exposed via cached public GET /v1/website-configuration endpoint.

models.title: Email & Notification Templates Model
models.overview: Customizable HTML email templates for OTP verification, welcome emails, and plan invoices.
models.purpose: Stores dynamic email copy and subject lines with mustache-style placeholder variables.

keyFields.name: subject
keyFields.description: Email subject line template

keyFields.name: content
keyFields.description: HTML email body with {{variables}}

keyFields.name: status
keyFields.description: 0: Inactive, 1: Active, 2: Deleted

notes: Rendered at runtime by templateHelpers utility during email dispatch.

middlewares.title: JWT Authentication Guard
middlewares.overview: Passport.js JWT Bearer token authentication middleware verifying authorization headers.
notes: Validates signature using JWT_SECRET from configuration.
Rejects expired or tampered tokens with 401 Unauthorized.
Attaches authenticated user document to req.user.

middlewares.title: RBAC Section Permission Guard
middlewares.overview: Dynamic authorization middleware checking user role privileges (canView, canCreate, canUpdate, canDelete).
notes: Extracts user role and queries tbl_roles for section privileges.
Grants automatic bypass for system administrators.
Returns 403 Forbidden if user lacks the required permission.

middlewares.title: Role Scope & Hierarchy Guard
middlewares.overview: Enforces role boundary protection preventing sellers from modifying admin accounts.
notes: Verifies operator role hierarchy before role updates.
Ensures seller team members can only be managed by their owner.

middlewares.title: Joi Schema Validation Middleware
middlewares.overview: Request payload validator enforcing schema constraints on body, query, and path parameters.
notes: Validates request data against defined Joi schemas.
Strips unknown properties and enforces strict types.
Returns 400 Bad Request with precise validation error messages.

middlewares.title: Global Error Converter & Handler
middlewares.overview: Centralized Express error handling pipeline normalizing errors into standardized JSON envelopes.
notes: Converts unknown errors (e.g. Mongoose, CastError) into ApiError instances.
Formats final response as { status, message, stack? }.
Hides stack traces in production environment.

middlewares.title: IP Rate Limiter Middleware
middlewares.overview: Brute-force protection throttling authentication and OTP solicitation requests.
notes: Restricts repeated failed login and OTP requests from the same IP.
Prevents denial of service and credential stuffing attacks.

middlewares.title: Universal OTP Security Guard
middlewares.overview: API Key authorization middleware guarding programmatic universal OTP generation.
notes: Validates x-api-key header against server configured secret.
Protects automated test environments and staging OTP endpoints.

utilities.title: ApiError Custom Exception Class
utilities.overview: Standardized operational error class extending native Error with HTTP status codes.
notes: Accepts statusCode, message, isOperational flag, and custom stack.
Used universally across controllers and services for throwing expected errors.

utilities.title: catchAsync Controller Wrapper
utilities.overview: Higher-order utility wrapping asynchronous Express route handlers to forward unhandled rejections to next().
notes: Eliminates redundant try/catch blocks in controller methods.
Guarantees all Promise rejections reach the centralized error handler.

utilities.title: System Audit Activity Logger
utilities.overview: Asynchronous background helper persisting admin and seller activity diffs to tbl_system_logs.
notes: Captures operator ID, action name, module, IP address, and changed fields.
Executed in non-blocking fashion without delaying HTTP responses.

utilities.title: Object Property Whitelist Utility
utilities.overview: Safe utility creating an object composed of selected whitelisted properties.
notes: Extracts search, page, limit, and filter parameters cleanly from req.query.
Guards against prototype pollution and unintended query injection.

utilities.title: Multer File Uploader Utility
utilities.overview: Configured Multer storage engine handling avatar images, blog banners, and media uploads.
notes: Validates image MIME types (JPEG, PNG, WebP) and 5MB size limits.
Generates unique random filenames to avoid file collisions.

utilities.title: Diagnostic Service Error Logger
utilities.overview: Formatted console and Winston logger capturing contextual runtime diagnostics.
notes: Categorizes errors by action_type for quick debugging in development.
Integrates with Morgan HTTP logger in production.

plugins.title: Mongoose toJSON Serialization Plugin
plugins.overview: Custom Mongoose plugin transforming documents into clean API response JSON objects.
notes: Deletes private fields like password and __v.
Transforms _id to id string representation automatically.
Applied globally across all application Mongoose schemas.

plugins.title: Mongoose Pagination & Query Plugin
plugins.overview: High-performance pagination plugin adding paginate() static method to Mongoose models.
notes: Handles sortBy, limit, page, and populate options seamlessly.
Returns { results, page, limit, totalPages, totalResults } standard envelope.

plugins.title: Common Pagination Envelope Helper
plugins.overview: Transforms raw pagination counters into unified API response envelopes.
notes: Ensures consistent response metadata across admin and seller tables.
